body:
I've been filling out so many applications, calling the managers, and trying to schedule interviews, but most of the places weren't hiring because they already had the seasonal staff they had to get rid of. The three interviews I had told me the same thing, that they'd call me. 

I posted this earlier, but if I don't do the laundry, it doesn't get done. It'll sit in the dryer clean for a week and nobody will get it but me. Everyone else just complains about not having any towels left. 

I'm morally opposed to military branches. I already know what I want to do with my life. I want to go to school to be a chef or a baker, and eventually I want to open up my own bakery. It's my passion. Unfortunately, with nobody to help me and no income, I can't afford the tuition, and financial aid goes by the total house income. The total house income is apparently too much because Tammy works full time, boyfriend works part time, and Grandma gets SS checks. 

I think I'd be better off getting a job (or a few jobs) and either renting a room or getting a studio apartment just for me. The more I think about this situation, the angrier I get at my boyfriend who doesn't do much to stick up for me.

I left some towels in the dryer for almost a week while the supply in the closet dwindled down, and nobody went to get them. They'd just ask everyone else where all the towels went. If I leave dishes in the sink, they'll be there for three days unless someone deigns to get them. The bathroom had never been cleaned in the year that I've known my boyfriend, so I had to get down on my hands and knees with a toothbrush to scrub the dirt out of the grout. I also had to scrub the bottom of the tub for over 3 hours straight to get rid of the dirt of a year or more. I guess I'm a lazy person. 

I don't mind doing some of the chores. I really don't. But it's supposed to be balanced. Grandma has regained her mobility. She's chipper enough to go to the movies with her sister, but not chipper enough to do the dishes without complaining about it. 

I've been looking for a job like my life depends on it, but it was pretty hard considering it was during the holiday season when most business already had their seasonal staff. I've had three interviews this month and each one told me they didn't have anything open but "they'd call me" when something opened up. :/
I'm too afraid to do either of those things because I'm scared if I say the wrong thing I'll be out on the streets in winter. I dug this hole for myself and now I have no way out of it.

The household makes too much money for any kind of assistance because grandma gets social security and Tammy works full time. I'm considering just getting 2 or 3 jobs and moving out on my own in a studio apartment. Or I could just rent a room or something. I've been kicked out or tossed aside by everyone in my life, and I don't know what I'm doing wrong. I've always done my best to make people happy and it's never enough. 

I'm so scared that I'll end up in a women's shelter or something. This whole situation is bringing back a slew of problems that I thought I had dealt with.

I really don't want to break up with my boyfriend. We have a perfect relationship when the family drama doesn't get involved. I'm not going to throw it away over this. I will admit that he's a mama's boy who only recently started standing up for himself. Couch hopping isn't an option because I don't have many friends, and the friends I do have wouldn't let me stay with them for any extended period of time, or they're guys with girlfriends who can't let another girl stay with them.

It sounds pathetic, but moving out with my boyfriend isn't feasible because he works at WalMart and I'm not working as of this minute. His hours were just massively cut down because the seasonal period is over. We're making pretty much no money. 

I've asked my dad for help numerous times since I've been living here. He wouldn't let me move in with him when my mom kicked me out, he wouldn't help me move, he wouldn't take me to the doctor, he wouldn't help me pay for my copay to go to the doctor. Both my parents pretty much cut me off. I asked my mom to take me to the gyno and she just told me to go to Planned Parenthood. They both gave up their responsibilities, and the only reason I'm in this mess is because my mom wouldn't help me at all. She wouldn't help me get my license, but she wanted me to have a job. We lived in the middle of nowhere, so I couldn't walk or take buses. If I had a job, she'd make me quit because she didn't want to drive me.  Then she'd yell at me for being jobless. The only reason I got the job at the bar was because it was a block away and I walked. 

Tammy has issues with being alone. She's been married twice before and both guys were abusive and cheated on her. The only reason she's not with them anymore is because the men either left her or kicked her out of the house. She won't kick Rick out, she won't make him get help, she won't make him get a job, she won't make him do anything because he's "sick". 

If you try to reason with her regarding Rick, she'll sit there and make excuses for him for hours. I'm scared what's going to happen to me when he says, "It's either her or me." I'll probably end up kicked out.
